jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Key responsibilities Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse. Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. jobs.description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. jobs.title: Finance Team Lead (d/f/m)
jobs.description: A bit about the finance function at Luminovo Over the last 4 years, Luminovo has grown on a 73% compounding growth rate. Throughout this time, Luminovo’s Finance team has consisted of never more than 1.5-2 FTE and a part-time leader (Benedikt). The leadership role is graduating and needs to become full-time. Apart from that, we’re good for years to come and find delight in keeping the team as small as possible! We love to overwhelm our financial service providers with demands for better API and are often leading our Claude’s lines-of-code company dashboards. Your role Build a finance function that scales through better systems, not a bigger team. We’re making our finance leadership a full-time role. You’ll lead and coach a team of two while staying close to the work: accounts, cash, reporting and the systems behind them. We want a finance operator who enjoys building with code and AI, not just introducing new tools. What you’ll own Own daily closing across our organisations on at least two continents. Improve the automation and controls behind it, whether the system is already running or still needs work when you join. Build automatic financial feedback loops across Luminovo. Give leaders the information they need where they work, and use code and AI to automate routine decisions so people can focus on complex judgement. Keep shareholders and lenders informed with timely, accurate reporting they can trust. Protect our cash position. Own the connection between forecasts and reality across payables, receivables, treasury and working capital. Help colleagues make better financial decisions. Coach team leads and company leadership on returns, trade-offs and the opportunity cost of each investment. Lead, coach and mentor your team of two. Grow the team’s capabilities and the quality of our systems rather than relying on more headcount. What you bring Hands-on finance ownership across accounting, cash and reporting. You’re comfortable moving between operational detail and financial decisions with company leadership. A builder’s approach to finance. You can show systems or workflows you’ve personally improved or automated using code and AI. The ability to coach a small team, build reliable controls and make financial information useful to people outside finance. German is a plus, not a requirement. Location and language This is a full-time role with a minimum of five days per month in our Munich office. Being based permanently in Munich is preferred but not required. ⚡️ About Luminovo Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry . We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain. To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million . Our core principles: putting people first & building great things As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍 Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. jobs.title: Research Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Position description   At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.     What you will do Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible. Develop Agentic Workflows : Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities. Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase. Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools. Engineer Data Pipelines : Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale. Translate Prototypes to Products : Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base. Communicate and Evangelize : Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience and qualifications Must have: Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages. Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures. Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy. Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes. Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions. The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics. Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads. Plus: Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc.. Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc. Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).      Additional comments This role is based in Bochum. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description: About the team: The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp. We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success. As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter. We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.   What you'll do: Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems. Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users. Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers. Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence. Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement. Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.   You'll be great for this role if you have: Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems. Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have. A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly. A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams. A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic. Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp. Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential. Why you should join SumUp: 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup 🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks . 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&amp

Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast. Junior Data Scientist Berlin, On-site Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day. You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale, and learn from them directly. You get real problems from week one, and the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more. What You'll Do 🎯 Build models that predict user value, engagement and reward behaviour, and see them live in our product Run A/B tests on offers, rewards and ranking, and work out what actually caused the result Build and fix the data pipelines your models depend on Take on new problems with no playbook yet, from first idea to production What You'll Bring 💡 Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked You quickly see which number matters and which question to answer first Proof that you aim high: a project, result or choice where you went past "good enough" when nobody asked you to Bonus: a strong result in a Kaggle challenge, hackathon or competition, or a system you built and fixed yourself when it broke Why Almedia A small, selective team of very sharp people. We keep it small on purpose, so every hire raises the bar Equity in Almedia. Every Berlin-based employee gets a stake, so you share in what you help build Top-of-market pay as the baseline. jobs.description: Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders. Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Senior Growth Manager (Berlin) Salary Range: €65k-€90k At a Glance You'll own a real book of business. This is a full 360 degree role with a sales and account management motion. Quota chasing is not the job but you'll have full top-line ownership and will not only shape the work but also execute it. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes. Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong. Run the ROAS dial. Tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Translate cap-fill outcomes and retention targets into bid moves. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day. Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint. Translate between commercial and technical teams . When a partner reports cost-data drift, you debug, push our engineering teams for an ETA, and frame the response back to the partner. Ship the playbook. Document improvements to the Growth team's standard operating procedures every week. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our Director or CEO. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Senior team treats you as the named owner. You're already covering for a peer's vacation. You've spotted at least one non-obvious revenue lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: Within a few years, the path runs from regional accounts to country ownership to multi-country or vertical leadership (gaming, non-gaming) to regional head (EMEA) or global. What You’ll Bring 💡 You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not just collect a title. You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. A 15% cohort revenue drop on a daily view? You spot it in under 30 seconds and you explain it in two sentences a non-technical listener gets. You're bilingual in the best sense , equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day. Bonus points if you: Know your way around platform-marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, and ARPU. If you don't yet, you will by week 2 - we'll onboard you on the math. Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role. Have hands-on experience with MMPs like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular. You can read postbacks, navigate attribution disputes, and explain View-Through Attribution to a confused partner. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.</p> <p>We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.</p> <p>We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.</li> <li>Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.</li> <li>Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.</li> <li>Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.</li> <li>Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You’ll be great for this role if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.</li> <li>Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.</li> <li>A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.</li> <li>A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.</li> <li>A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.</li> <li>Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt&nbsp; powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Data Scientist</strong> to join our <strong>Berlin </strong>&nbsp;team. In this role, you’ll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact.&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.</p> <p><strong>About Our Data Science Organisation</strong></p> <p>We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.</p> <p>Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. jobs.title: Post-Silicon Validation Team Leader
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor and provide technical direction to the Post-Silicon Validation team Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation and characterisation tests on pre-silicon platforms ahead of first silicon Deploy and debug validation and characterisation tests on first silicon, from initial bring-up through to full functional coverage and silicon characterisation Develop automated test frameworks and regression suites to raise validation throughput Architect and drive continuous improvement of test infrastructure, methodology and processes Analyse test results, isolate failures and root-cause defects across hardware, firmware and software boundaries Enable and support production systems, firmware and software teams through their bring-up Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure used across the programme Feed findings back to architects and designers to shape future silicon Report programme status and progress to programme management Required Qualifications 8+ years in post-silicon validation in digital ASIC environments Experience in characterisation, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis Experience leading or technically directing a validation or test engineering team Strong low-level, system software development Excellent working knowledge of digital ASIC design and architecture Ability to work across teams, abstraction layers and programming languages to root-cause deep and complex issues Strong system debug, log analysis and failure isolation skills Ability to drive cross-functional work and communicate clearly with engineering and programme management Preferred Qualifications Driver-level experience with PCIe, memory technologies (LPDDR, DDR, HBM) or peripherals such as I2C, I3C and SPI Knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks — PLLs, high-speed PHYs — and on-chip control and communication protocols Experience with RISC-V CPUs, system IP and associated debug tooling Experience with AMBA protocols Understanding of ML applications and their workloads What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role. jobs.title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.</p> <p>Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context &amp; Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> &l

jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables.</strong></p> <p>L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.<br>Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.&nbsp;</p> <p>Et tout commence par vous.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>En tant que <strong>Senior AI Strategist</strong>, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.</p> <p>Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.</p> <p>Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.</p> <p><br><strong>Activités &amp; Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Analyses, business cases &amp; prototypage</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery, livrables &amp; collaboration</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous produisez des sections de livrables de niveau C-suite, rédigez les storylines du stream, participez aux synthèses exécutives sur votre périmètre et construisez un narratif qui appuie la recommandation et emporte l’adhésion. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Relation client &amp; développement commercial</strong></li> </ul

jobs.description: <h2><strong>🧡 About Alma</strong></h2> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯  Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés. Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux. Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail. Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène. jobs.description: Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois) Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie   Contexte : École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.   Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants : Systèmes Numériques Energie Environnement Matériaux et Procédés   Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr .   Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air.   Contexte : L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. jobs.description: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. Bias for Action We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory. Ownership We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results. About the role When your product is the front door to someone else’s product, security isn’t a feature, it’s the product. Every login and every signup that goes through Prelude is a moment where our customers trust us with their users, their phone numbers, and their reputation. As our first dedicated Security Engineer, you’ll own security across Prelude: our cloud infrastructure, our codebase, our APIs and SDKs, and the way we handle the sensitive data that flows through them. You’ll start from solid ground: a certified ISO 27001 and SOC 2 program, short-lived credentials across our cloud environment, and a 24/7 on-call rotation. You’ll run that foundation day to day and take it further, with direct support from Engineering leadership and the founders. This is a hands-on IC role: you’ll write code, ship guardrails, and fix things yourself, and set the standard for how every engineer at Prelude thinks about security. What you’ll do Own the security of our cloud infrastructure. Harden our AWS and ClickHouse environments and make the secure path the default for every service we deploy. Build security into how we ship. Run threat modeling and design reviews with engineers, review critical code paths, and extend our automated checks in CI/CD (adding dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container and IaC security scanning) without slowing the team down. Protect our customers’ users and their data. Personal data is at the heart of our product. Design and enforce the controls that protect it (encryption, access control, retention, and auditability) in line with GDPR and our customers’ expectations. Mature detection and incident response. Extend our logging, alerting, and runbooks to spot abuse and compromise early, lead incident response when something goes wrong, and write honest post-mortems the next morning. Drive compliance and customer trust. Maintain and mature our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications through surveillance and recertification audits. Own our answers to enterprise security questionnaires, and be the technical voice of Prelude’s security posture with our largest customers. Partner with our anti-fraud team. Fraud here isn’t theoretical. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing. Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining. Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design. Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data. Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up. Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production. Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering. Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems. Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production. Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs. Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions. Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage. Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration. Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis. Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting. Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products. jobs.description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Lead to establish Rivia’s marketing function and build a reliable channel for qualified pipeline generation. You will shape our brand identity as a credible, emerging AI-native technology company transforming clinical trials, while owning both strategy and execution across product marketing, events, field marketing and targeted campaigns. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Client Solutions and Strategic Partnerships. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has experienced excellent marketing execution in a scaling company and is excited to build with limited resources, move quickly and own commercial outcomes. Ownership and Commercial Collaboration You will own marketing strategy, messaging, programs, execution, brand visibility and performance reporting. Marketing is accountable for marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced qualified pipeline, with attribution agreed jointly with Sales. Sales owns opportunities, deal progression and closing. You will partner with Strategic Partnerships on coordinated programs, with Product on market-facing narratives and launches, and with industry experts on thought leadership. You will recommend budget allocations for CEO approval and manage specialist agencies while retaining ownership of strategy and quality. What excites you: Building a marketing function from the ground up and setting a high standard for execution. Turning complex clinical trial technology into clear, compelling stories for biotech buyers. Creating memorable events, targeted campaigns and original ways to engage hard-to-reach decision-makers. Combining strategic judgment with hands-on delivery, from copy and briefs to vendors and follow-up. Being measured by qualified pipeline and commercial impact rather than vanity metrics. Working with ambitious colleagues in a fast-moving Series A environment, with autonomy and direct access to the CEO. Own product launches end to end, coordinating launch assets, website updates, PR, sales enablement and customer proof points. Select high-value conferences and field initiatives based on target accounts and opportunity potential. Own event strategy, budgets, vendors, logistics, invitations, meeting programs and follow-up; organize Rivia-hosted events and an annual customer launch day. Develop creative, targeted programs that connect decision-maker engagement to qualified opportunities. Run targeted LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns in coordination with Sales and Strategic Partnerships. Manage multiple marketing projects and external agencies with clear briefs, timelines and quality standards. Establish mark

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.   Summary of Position: The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team.  This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide.  The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products.  Position Responsibilities Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives. Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe. Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations. Incorporate evidence gaps needed for European payers into evidence generation plans Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies. Serve as Europe HEOR partner to Europe Market Access for access and reimbursement dossiers by providing country-specific adaptations of models, methodology guidance, and scientific reviews that support country-level deliverables. Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses. Work closely across Global HEOR and cross-functional teams to inform endpoint, patient-reported outcome, and utility data collection strategy for clinical development programs so that trials generate evidence acceptable to payers and HTA bodies. Manage external HEOR vendors, budgets, and contracts, ensuring quality and timely delivery across competing priorities. Translate complex HEOR outputs and requirements into plain-language value narratives for internal leadership and external payers. Candidate Requirements Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services

jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱 Wat breng jij? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂 Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027 Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. jobs.title: Marketing Project Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Project Management meets Hands-on Marketing & AI 📍 München, Maxvorstadt | Hybrid | Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) 💰 50.000–60.000 € brutto/Jahr , abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation Ein neues Kundenprojekt kommt rein. Unterschiedliche Anforderungen, neue Herausforderungen, viele Möglichkeiten. Während andere erst einmal überlegen, wer sich darum kümmern könnte, denkst du schon: „Spannend. Ich übernehme das. Let's go!“ Du verstehst, was der Kunde braucht, entwickelst passende Lösungen, kalkulierst ein Angebot und bringst das Projekt auf den Weg. Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten, packst selbst mit an und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee ein richtig gutes Ergebnis wird. Dabei ist KI für dich nicht einfach ein nettes Extra. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, baust dir eigene Workflows und hast den Anspruch, dich in neue Tools schnell einzuarbeiten und sie wirklich auszureizen. Ob Kampagne, Website oder Content: Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können. Aber du weißt, wie du die richtigen Menschen, Ideen und Technologien zusammenbringst. Du bist nicht nur dabei. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst mit und machst Dinge möglich. Was du bei uns machst Du übernimmst abwechslungsreiche Marketingprojekte von A bis Z – von der ersten Anfrage bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du übernimmst Ownership. Du machst Kundenprojekte zu deinen eigenen, führst sie eigenständig von Briefing und Konzeption bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass alles läuft. Du berätst und entwickelst Lösungen. Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Kunden, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst passende Konzepte und Maßnahmen. Du kalkulierst und planst. Du erstellst Angebote, schätzt Aufwände ein, planst Ressourcen und behältst Budgets, Timings und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick. Du packst selbst mit an. Ob Konzepte, Präsentationen, Texte, Briefings oder andere Marketing-Deliverables: Du setzt Aufgaben auch selbst um, statt ausschließlich zu delegieren. Du nutzt KI und entwickelst neue Workflows. Mit Tools wie ChatGPT und Claude optimierst du deine Arbeit, automatisierst Prozesse und probierst neue Wege aus, von denen auch das Team profitiert. Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten. Du steuerst interne Teams, Kreative, Entwickler und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für klare Briefings und gute Ergebnisse. Du bist Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden. Du führst Meetings, präsentierst Ergebnisse, steuerst Erwartungen und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit. Dich erwartet ein bunter Mix aus Kunden, Branchen und Marketingdisziplinen. Langfristig kannst du je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen auch eigene Schwerpunkte entwickeln. KI ist für uns kein Buzzword Wir gehören zu den Agenturen, die KI-Tools gezielt, geplant und mit echtem Mehrwert einsetzen – nicht als Experiment, sondern im Arbeitsalltag. Darauf sind wir stolz, und genau das bauen wir weiter aus. Schon heute nutzen wir eigene KI-Workflows, zum Beispiel für Projektsteuerung, Konzepte, Umsetzung und interne Prozesse. Du musst dafür kein Entwickler oder Automatisierungsexperte sein. Aber du solltest KI-Tools sicher beherrschen und Lust haben, unsere Workflows weiterzuentwickeln und neue zu bauen, von denen das ganze Team und unsere Kunden profitieren. jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & PR
jobs.description: Wir machen Content. Für andere. Für uns selbst kommen wir viel zu selten dazu. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere eigene Außenwirkung in die Hand nimmt: Social-Kanäle, Pressearbeit, Website, Newsletter und so weiter! Das heißt nicht Kaffee holen und Listen pflegen, sondern: Du bist die Person, durch die die Branche mitbekommt, was wir eigentlich alles bauen. Awards, Cases, Launches, Team-News, Festival-Auftritte. Wir haben viel zu erzählen und erzählen es gerade viel zu leise. Du musst nichts davon schon perfekt können. Wir brauchen jemanden, der schreiben kann, der mitdenkt und der Dinge zu Ende bringt. Den Rest zeigen wir dir. Aufgaben Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst: Unsere Social-Kanäle: Du planst, textest und veröffentlichst unsere eigenen Postings – Cases, Behind the Scenes, Team, Awards. LinkedIn ist unsere wichtigste Bühne. Dort findet unsere Branche statt: Kunden,Partner, potenzielle Kolleg:innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass dort regelmäßig etwas passiert, was nicht nach Unternehmensmeldung klingt. Instagram läuft parallel. Award-Einreichungen: Du bereitest Cases für Awards und Festivals auf. Daten sammeln, Texte bauen, Fristen im Blick behalten. Mitdenken: Wenn dir auffällt, dass wir eine gute Geschichte liegen lassen, sagst du Bescheid. Oder machst sie einfach. Die Strategie dahinter machen wir gemeinsam. Du musst nicht alleine entscheiden, wo die Reise geht – aber du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass tatsächlich etwas rausgeht. Qualifikation Was wir wirklich brauchen: Du kannst schreiben. Klar, lesbar, ohne Marketing-Floskeln und bestenfalls ist KI nur ein Begleiter. Das ist der Kern dieser Rolle. Du bist eingeschrieben – idealerweise in Kommunikation, Medien, Marketing, Journalismus, PR oder etwas Benachbartem. Fachrichtung ist uns weniger wichtig als Schreiben und Kopf. Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Auch die unspektakulären. Ein Presseverteiler pflegt sich nicht von selbst. Du hast ein Gefühl für unsere Branche oder zumindest echtes Interesse daran, was Creator, Brands und Agenturen gerade umtreibt. Nice to have, kein Ausschluss: Erste Erfahrung in Agentur, Redaktion, Hochschulmarketing oder einem Verein Du hast schon mal einen Newsletter gebaut (Mailchimp, Brevo, Substack, egal) Du bist auf LinkedIn selbst unterwegs und weißt, was dort gelesen wird und was durchrutscht Grundlagen in Canva oder CapCut Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift Was du nicht brauchst: Agenturerfahrung, ein fertiges Portfolio oder Kenntnisse in zwölf Tools.
